mathematics.single_hardest_spectral_gap: Proposed sufficient-condition research target, not an established theorem: for H=-A+lambda V on l2(Z^3), V_x iid Uniform[-1,1], find q in (0,1), lambda_0>0 and a deterministic nonempty bounded open interval I of nonzero spectral weight such that for each fixed 0<lambda<lambda_0, each site x and each compact interval J contained in I, sup_{0<eta<1} E integral_J [eta+Im<b_x,(H^x-E-i eta)^(-1)b_x>]^(-q)dE<infinity. H^x is the compression deleting x and b_x has the six hopping coefficients. This bound would supply a conditional spectral route; it would not prove GOE microscopic statistics. No proof of this bound is supplied.
